features.name: Self-Billing Invoices
features.description: A new functionality that allows customers to create invoices on behalf of their vendors for goods or services received, reducing manual processing steps and improving accuracy and compliance.
caveats: Electronic invoicing based on self-billing invoice is not yet covered and planned for next release

features.name: Self-Billing Agreement Field on Vendor Card
features.description: A new boolean field on the invoicing fast tab of the vendor card that enables automatic self-billing invoice creation when toggled on.

features.name: Posted Self-Billing Invoice Number Series
features.description: A new number series configuration in Purchase and Payable Setup that serves as the external document number for self-billing invoices, automatically populated without manual entry.

features.name: Self-Billing Invoice Report Selection
features.description: New report selection for self-billing invoices in Purchase report selection, using report 413 (self-billing invoice) to format and print customer-created invoices.

features.name: Electronic Invoicing for Self-Billing
features.description: Electronic invoicing capability based on self-billing invoices is planned for a future release after initial feedback is gathered on the self-billing functionality.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is something what we plan to deliver uh next release
caveats: Not yet available; planned for subsequent release
